notes: - Excel report: the Progress column is the orange bar only; the number stays in the % column

- Fixed the level pills and header being squeezed on the Audit Findings page
- The SSM Audit title now lines up with the workspace below it

- Fixed the Audit Findings list stopping halfway down the page
- Level pills: the first click narrows to that level, further clicks add or remove levels

- Rules screen: switch any check off to leave it out of the findings, Dashboard, and Excel report
- Excel report progress bars now fill their cells
- Shorter release notes

- Relationship checks now recognise links carried by the hierarchy, so fewer control, RIO, and VESDA findings
- Fire alarm panel recognition improved
- Fiber distribution unit check updated to match how FDUs are placed in practice
- Loading indicator tracks the percentage accurately
- Smoother, step-by-step progress while importing and exporting
- Visual fixes across the app: drawer findings, sidebar counts, and table clipping
- Show in hierarchy now lands on and highlights the right row
- UPN SEC recognised as Security; MISC rows now carry a review note instead of an error
- UPN RR recognised as the CSA system
- Hierarchy jump highlights its target; menu labels tidied
- Fixed a findings-list display gap and dashboard clipping; dashboard sections moved into tabs

- Excel report: equipment with several findings is one merged block
- New report layout: one tab per finding level
- Export chooser: include, pre-tick, or leave out findings by level or by check
- Much smaller Excel reports that open cleanly on large registries
- Fixed the update download
- Every check on the Rules screen has a worked example
- Redesigned Excel report: bigger progress bars, tick-box Actioned column, clearer nesting colours, highlighted problem cells
- Update check shows its result and has a Check again button
- Snappier transitions
- Smoother motion throughout the app
- Fixed the menu on narrow windows
- One Filters panel for everything; the Dashboard now follows your filters and shows more

- New filters on Audit findings and several new checks from real registries
- Site-specific classifications and parent-as-dependency are now notes you can filter
- New Dashboard screen; finding levels renamed to Invalid, Rule broken, Check this, and Note
- Relationship diagrams on parent, dependency, and loop findings; guide refreshed
- Item Master checks handle any site prefix; wording fixes
- New Excel report with progress tracking; every check rewritten in plain language; aligned with Rev21
- Import, comparison, hierarchy, and performance fixes
- Fuller Project Comparison with hierarchy, differences, and equipment mapping views
- New SSM Hierarchy screen with search, filters, and equipment details
- Side-by-side project comparison and a searchable Rules screen
- Audit refocused on integrity, SOP conformance, and commissioning logic, with new confidence-rated checks
- Header rows are no longer audited as physical equipment
- Filters and sorting for findings; new commissioning-path checks
- First release of SSM Audit
